newsitem.title: SPAIN: Foreign buyers power Madrid stocks to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Foreign buyers power Madrid stocks to new highs.

text.p: MADRID, Nov 6 (Reuter) 1620 GMT - Madrid stocks closed up sharply on Wednesday, hitting new highs buoyed by gains in bonds and other European bourses after U.S. election results.
Foreign investors were very much in evidence and the underlying tone points to more gains, dealers said.
The general index rose 4.00 points, 1.05 percent, to 384.69 while the Ibex added 53.38 points, 1.22 percent to 4,427.25.
Buying in Telefonica and Endesa in particular provided impetus, helped by strong international buying interest.
Fenosa also soared after Tuesday's nine-month results announcement, adding 27 pesetas to 872.
But negative sentiment persisted in Repsol, which shed 10 pesetas to 4,230.
"I think the market is going to carry on pushing up. It's very strong and there's substantial foreign interest, especially in Endesa and Telefonica," said a trader at Merrill Lynch.
Repsol was still dogged by forecasts that its nine-month results will be disappointing, although this has been expected since the beginning of the year, he added.
